environment.description: Application deployed on a standard EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2. PostgreSQL 14 with a single application-level database user (app_user) that has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables. The /data/tenants directory is an EBS volume mounted with default ext4 options. Container runs as root. No filesystem-level isolation between tenant directories. The documents table has a tenant_id column but no RLS policies are enabled - tenant filtering relies solely on the application query including tenant_id in the WHERE clause.

config.db_user: app_user with full DML on all tables
config.filesystem: ext4, default mount options, symlinks allowed
config.network: direct internet-facing ALB with no WAF
